title: ERC-8004 validation flow (specified, not officially deployed)
summary: The Validation Registry as the Draft text specifies it. The contracts README lists no Validation Registry address on any chain, so this flow describes the specification, not a supported deployment.

steps.label: Store request data
steps.detail: The owner stores everything the validator needs, including the inputs and outputs to check, at requestURI. requestHash is keccak256 of that payload and identifies the request.

steps.label: validationRequest(validatorAddress, agentId, requestURI, requestHash)
steps.detail: Must be called by the owner or an operator. Emits ValidationRequest.

failures.outcome: Reverts with "exists" in the reference code; the first owner to submit a hash occupies it.

steps.label: Fetch and check the work
steps.detail: The validator re-executes with stake behind it, checks a zkML proof or a TEE attestation. The method, incentives and slashing are outside the registry.

steps.label: validationResponse(requestHash, response, responseURI, responseHash, "soft")
steps.detail: Only the named validator may answer. response is 0 to 100, binary (0 or 100) or a spectrum. Emits ValidationResponse.

failures.condition: The caller is not the named validator

steps.label: validationResponse(requestHash, response, ..., "hard")
steps.detail: The validator may answer again for the same request, for example hard finality after soft. In the reference code a later answer may also lower the value, which an open issue reports as a rogue-validator risk.
